mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy, which leads to higher borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases above 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate signals an improving labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when RSAFS increases by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an expanding economy, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase, it signals a strengthening labor market in a high-unemployment regime, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when UNRATE > 6% and PAYEMS increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST decreases by more than 5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) increases, it signals accommodative monetary policy with rising inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.3% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP (GDPC1) coupled with a decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a shift towards service-oriented growth, which may lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced manufacturing profitability.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 0.5% QoQ and INDPRO decreases > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when GDPC1 increases by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter and INDPRO decreases by more than 0.5% month-over-month.
